founded_evidence: Fulham Football Club is London's oldest professional football club, having been established in 1879.
name: Fulham Football Club
notes: Revenue is the group's 'turnover and other income' (£194.8m, year to 30 June 2025); loss for the year £44.5m and net assets £316.1m per the same statement, but the club gives no pre-tax figure, so pretax_result is null. No revenue split, wages or debt figures are published on the club site; full accounts are on Companies House (Fulham Football Leisure Limited 03374347). Capacity: the club's own pages give 25,700 (Craven Cottage page, pre-Riverside Stand) and a planned c.29,600 after the Riverside Stand redevelopment (planning application page); the 2025/26 capacity 29,589 is from The Sporting News table via Yahoo Sports. Stadium ownership not stated. Valuation is Sportico's 2026 figure ($730m, in the CSV as 730 in $m); Fulham is not on Forbes' 2026 list. No institutional investors found; no front-of-shirt sponsor stated on the partners page (SBOTOP listed as Official Partner). Khan's 2013 purchase price is not stated on any page read.
ownership_summary: Owned by Shahid (Shad) Khan, who bought the club from Mohamed Al Fayed in summer 2013; beneficial ownership and control vest with Mr Khan and/or his children Tony and Shanna Khan. The chain on Companies House runs Fulham Football Club Limited <- Fulham Football Leisure Limited <- Cougar Holdco London Limited <- K2tr Family Holdings 2, Corp. (South Dakota), each holding 75% or more.
revenue_evidence: The Group generated turnover and other income for the year of £194.8m
